audience: teams that run a Meilisearch server for product, site or document search

useCases.title: Check the health of each index
useCases.text: List the indexes, then read the document count, storage size and indexing state of one index.

useCases.title: Find failed indexing tasks
useCases.text: List the tasks that are still processing or have failed. Open one task to read its error message.

useCases.title: Test search results
useCases.text: Run a typo-tolerant search with filters, sorting and facet counts. Run up to 20 searches over one or more indexes in one request.

useCases.title: Update product records
useCases.text: Add documents, or update them by id. Fields you do not send are kept. Then check the returned task.

useCases.title: Read the search settings of an index
useCases.text: Read the searchable, filterable and sortable attributes and the ranking rules of one index. Then read a page of its documents.
